function.name: court_info_get_case_status
function.description: Retrieves the status and trial dates for court cases from specified county courts. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

court.description: The county court where the case is filed.

details.description: Specific details required about the court case. Defaults to 'status'.

They want both status and trial date. So we can set details to "status" or "trial_date"? But the function only accepts one detail at a time. We might need to call twice per case: once for status, once for trial_date. But maybe we can pass details as default 'status', but then we need trial_date too. The function signature says details defaults to 'status'. It doesn't allow multiple. So we need to call twice per case. That would be four calls. But maybe we can call once per case with details unspecified, get status, then call again with details='trial_date' to get trial date. Let's do that.
